newsitem.title: UK: Some privatised utlities may escape UK labour tax.
newsitem.headline: Some privatised utlities may escape UK labour tax.

text.p: Some of the privatised utilities may escape Labour's planned windfall tax on excess profits, economics spokesman Gordon Brown said on Wednesday.

Brown told an election campaign news conference that he had determined the category of companies which would be affected by the tax but that in governent Labour would determine which of them had made excess profits.
"That is the responsibile thing to do. The chancellor of the exchequer sets the category of the companies affcted. He does not go around the country naming individual names."
An aide to Brown said afterwards that what he had said was consistent with long-expressed Labour policy.
